root_cause_of_prior_54_char_failure.symptom: A non-streaming review/retry call returned the 54-character sentinel 'No eligible LLM providers found for your current plan.' while the same turn's streaming leg served Ollama.
root_cause_of_prior_54_char_failure.cause: The registered local route declared the product-default quality 0.5, below the BPC planning floor. The stream leg used get_optimal_provider's absolute dispatchable fallback; generate_response stopped before that fallback. The retry therefore never reached the model.
root_cause_of_prior_54_char_failure.repair: generate_response now uses the same absolute dispatchable fallback under ATOM_LOCAL_ONLY when the ranked pool is empty; the route still passes the existing catalog, cooldown, local-only, policy and capability gates.

notes: This run did not need the one contract-only block-recovery retry: each reply included a schema-valid assessment block on the first generation (review_result fence for baseline and after restart; a JSON fence carrying the same schema for the unfamiliar case).

The run proves post-correction behavior and restart persistence for this fixture. It does not by itself upgrade the broader cross-domain judgment item (CR-009) or the renamed-schema restart item (CR-019).
The provider fallback is covered by TestNonStreamingAbsoluteFallback in backend/tests/test_f5_local_planning_eligibility.py.

A separate false-positive quota bench was observed during the first (failed) run: an instructor Mode.TOOLS retry dump contained a numeric 402 in its token logprobs, and the substring check benched the healthy Ollama route. The quota bench now requires a structured HTTP status or an explicit provider quota code, and refuses schema/protocol retry dumps; bare 'quota'/'more credits' prose is not evidence. Covered by the quota controls in tests/test_turn_budget_rca_fixes.py.
